paper_title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models Non-linearity, Sparsity, and   Attention-Sink-Free
caption: Comparison of massive activations and attention sink phenomena across different gating configurations. Row 1 (Baseline): Significant massive activations and attention sinks emerge after the 6th layer. Row 2 (SDPA Gating): Reduced activations and no attention sinks observed. Row 3 (Value Layer Gating): Similar activations to Row 2 but with residual attention sinks. Rows 4–5 (Reduced Sparsity via cross-head share and NS-sigmoid): Massive activations and attention sinks resemble the baseline.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: The graph illustrates the changes in the first token attention scores across different layers of a baseline model. The X-axis represents the layer number, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to beyond 20, marked at intervals of 5. The Y-axis denotes the first token attention score, also on a linear scale, spanning from 0.0 to 1.0 in increments of 0.2. A blue solid line represents the first token attention score, while a green dashed line indicates the mean score of 0.467. The blue line starts at a low value near 0.07 at layer 0, slightly decreases at layer 2, and then increases to around 0.1 by layer 5. It sharply rises to approximately 0.63 at layer 6, followed by fluctuations between 0.5 and 0.65 up to layer 16. The score then dips to around 0.5 at layer 18, peaks at about 0.78 at layer 19, reaches its highest point of roughly 0.86 at layer 21, and finally drops to around 0.45 at layer 23. The green dashed line remains constant at 0.467 across all layers.
model_annotations.Chinese: 该图表显示了基线模型中不同层的第一个token注意力分数。x轴标记为“层”，具有从0到23的线性刻度，间隔为5个单位。y轴标记为“第一个token注意力分数”，具有从0.0到1.0的线性刻度，间隔为0.2个单位。图表中有两条线：一条蓝色的实线代表“第一个token注意力分数”，和一条绿色的虚线代表平均注意力分数0.467。蓝色线在x轴的开始处从大约0.07开始，在第6层之前保持低位，然后显著增加到大约0.62，接着在第7层至第20层之间波动，峰值出现在第8层（0.62）、第13层（0.61）、第18层（0.77）和第20层（0.86），然后在x轴的末端下降到大约0.43。绿线在整个x轴范围内保持不变，维持在0.467的恒定平均值。
model_annotations.English: The plot shows the first token attention scores of the baseline model across different layers, comparing the attention scores to their mean value. The x-axis is labeled "layer" with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 20 with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "first token attention score" with a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The plot contains two lines: a blue solid line representing the first token attention score, and a green dashed line representing the mean attention score of 0.467. The blue line starts at approximately 0.07 at layer 0, decreases to about 0.06 at layer 2, then increases to around 0.62 at layer 7, before fluctuating between approximately 0.5 and 0.86 until layer 20, where it drops to about 0.45; it shows peaks at layer 7 (0.62), layer 18 (0.77), and layer 21 (0.86), with a decline to around 0.45 at layer 24. The green line remains constant at 0.467 across all layers.
